Apostrophes: it's, the dogs' bowl, ''it's italic'', '''bold's''', L'''arbre'' and ''''four''''.
Bold inside italic: ''italic and '''bold''' in it''.
Quotes that are never closed: ''italic until the end of the line
and '''bold until the end of the line

Headings: 
=Without spaces=
== With a trailing space == 
== Not a heading = because the sides differ
=== 
= = =
Not a heading: a = b and == in the middle == of a line.

Links: [[A page with spaces]], [[Page|]], [[|text]], [[]], [https://example.com], [not a link], [[Category:Hiking]], [[File:Sunrise.jpg|thumb|A sunrise]].
URLs: https://example.com/a_b_c. (https://example.com/x), [https://example.com/wiki/Foo_(bar) parentheses].

Lists that stop and start:
* one
* two
not an item
* a new list
:indented with a colon
; a term : and its definition

A space at the start of a line makes code:
 like this
  and this, with one more space

<nowiki>'''not bold''' and <b>not HTML</b></nowiki>, <code>'''not bold''' in code</code>, <pre>one line of pre</pre>

two lines</nowiki>
